posts.title: Does It Matter Who Is Talking? Widgets, Wisdom, and Artificial Intelligence
posts.description: In a world where authoritative messages are often crafted by unseen hands (like an AI devoid of character) a caution emerges: the messenger is crucial, especially when stakes are high. Trust is earned through proximity and character, not mere technological convenience. Without personal connection, blindly following distant voices is a perilous gamble.

posts.title: Who Holds the Keys? Genesis, Distant Voices, and the Authority of the Local Church
posts.description: In this second part of my series I discuss the authority of distant ministries like Answers in Genesis over local churches, particularly regarding interpretations of Genesis. posts.title: How Much Authority Should You Give Me? Reflection On My Pastor’s Challenge
posts.description: In a recent sermon, my pastor raised concerns about the online voices Christians follow, emphasizing that limited access to a teacher's character necessitates caution in granting them authority in one's life. Here I reflect on my own low-access status as a content creator, urging discernment in evaluating distant teachers while encouraging accountability and character awareness.
